{How can White damage Black's pawn structure and claim a small advantage?} 7.
Qf3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Develop your queen
and safely attack the f5 bishop.]} (7. Bxf6 $2 Qxf6 {Black has a good position.
Try again.}) (7. Qb3 $5 b6 {Black doesn't have to allow doubled pawns after
Qb3, although White still has chances for an advantage. Try to find a more
popular queen move for White.}) (7. Nf3 $2 {This is a playable developing move,
but it doesn't cause Black and difficulties. Try to find a better move.}) (7.
Nge2 $2 {This is a playable developing move, but it doesn't cause Black and
difficulties. Try to find a better move.}) 7... Bg6 {Good start! How can you
damage Black's pawn structure?} 8. Bxf6 {[%wrong There's a stronger move to
damage Black's pawn structure. Try to find it.] [%hint Trade pieces to make
Black double pawns on the kingside.]} (8. Qxf6 $2 gxf6 {Black is winning. Try
again.}) 8... Qxf6 {Good move! What's next?} 9. Qxf6 {[%wrong There's a better
move to damage Black's pawn structure. Try to find it.] [%hint Trade queens to
force Black to accept doubled pawns.] Well played! Black must recapture on f6
and White has chances for an advantage thanks to the doubled, isolated f-pawns.
} *

should White continue the attack?} 11. Nxd5 {[%wrong There's a better move.

Nf3 $2 Qe7 {Black is doing well. Try again.}) 12... Nd7 {Nice move! Keep it up!
} 13. Bxd7+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again.] [%hint Lure the Black
king forward.]} (13. Qxd5 $2 Rd8 {Black is OK. Try again.}) (13. Nf3 $2 Qxg4 {
Black is better. Try again.}) (13. Bg3 $2 Qh1 {Black is winning. Try again.})
13... Kxd7 {Great move! What's next?} 14. Qxd5+ {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find it.] [%hint Fork Black's king and rook.]} (14. Qb5+ $2 Ke7 {
White is only slightly better. Try again.}) (14. Nf3 $2 Qd8 {Black is doing
well. Try again.}) 14... Kc8 {Great job! Black's last move was a mistake, but
White was winning anyway. How can you checkmate in two moves?} 15. Rc1+ {
[%wrong There's no mate next move. Try again.] [%hint Bring your rook into the
attack.]} (15. Qxa8+ $5 {White is winning, but there's a faster path to mate.
Try to find it.}) (15. Qc6+ $5 {White is winning, but there's a faster path to
mate. Try to find it.}) 15... Bc2 {Well played! Where's the mate?} 16. Rxc2# {
[%wrong That's not mate. Try again.] [%hint Look at your checks. Which one is
mate?] Well done!} *

{The most popular option in this position is to develop the light-squared
bishop to take advantage of Black's vulnerable d5 pawn. How should you do that?
} 6. g3 {[%wrong There's a better move to allow the f1-bishop to develop. Try
to find it.] [%hint Let the f1-bishop reach the g2 square.]} (6. dxc5 $5 {
This is a good move, but there's a more popular option that focuses on
developing the f1-bishop. Try to find it.}) (6. e3 $2 Nf6 {Black will reach a
comfortable isolated queen's pawn position. Try to find a way to develop the
bishop to target d5.}) (6. e4 $2 dxe4 {Black wins a pawn. Try to find a better
way to let your f1-bishop develop.}) (6. g4 $2 Bxg4 {White wins a pawn. Try to
find a better option with your g-pawn.}) 6... Nf6 {Good start! How should you
develop the f1-bishop?} 7. Bg2 {[%wrong There's a better developing move. Try
to find a good square for your f1-bishop.] [%hint Develop your bishop and
prepare to castle.] Well played! The bishop on g2 will soon target a backward
or isolated pawn on d5.} (7. Bh3 $2 Bxh3 {Black wins a piece. Try to find a
better square for the bishop.}) *

{White usually places a bishop on g5 when possible in the Exchange Variation.
How should Black take advantage of White's inaccurate Bf4 move?} 5... Bd6 {
[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find a way to develop and trade-off
the f4 bishop.] [%hint Develop and offer to trade for the f4-bishop.] Good
move! White must either lose time by moving or defending the bishop, or White
can trade the bishop and help Black to develop the queen.} (5... Bf5 $5 {
This is reasonable, but the best move develops and attacks the f4-bishop. How
should you do that?}) (5... c5 $5 {This is reasonable, but the best move
develops and attacks the f4-bishop. How should you do that?}) (5... c6 $5 {
This is reasonable, but the best move develops and attacks the f4-bishop. How
should you do that?}) (5... Be7 $2 6. e3 {This is playable but doesn't take
advantage of White's imprecise move order to win a tempo on the f4-bishop. How
can you do that?}) (5... Bb4 $2 {This is playable but doesn't take advantage
of White's imprecise move order to win a tempo on the f4-bishop. How can you
do that?}) *

{White's move order isn't the most challenging for Black. How should you take
advantage with a good developing move?} 7... Bf5 {[%wrong There's a better
developing move. Try to find a way to develop and control the b1-h7 diagonal.]
[%hint Develop and control the b1-h7 diagonal.] Good move! Black will be able
to find active squares for each piece. This is why White usually plays an
early Qc2 or Bd3 to prevent Bf5.} (7... h6 $5 {This is OK, but the best move
takes control of the b1-h7 diagonal. How should you do that?}) (7... Ne4 $5 {
This is OK, but the best move takes control of the b1-h7 diagonal. How should
you do that?}) (7... O-O $5 {This is OK, but the best move takes control of
the b1-h7 diagonal. How should you do that?}) (7... Bd7 $2 8. Bd3 {There's a
more active square for the bishop. Try to find it.}) (7... Be6 $2 8. Bd3 {
There's a more active square for the bishop. Try to find it.}) (7... Bg4 $5 {
This is OK, but there's an even better square for the bishop. Try to find it.})

{How should White force Black to soon accept either an isolated or backward
pawn on the queenside?} 21. b5 {[%wrong There's a better move to attack on the
queenside. Try to force a pawn trade.] [%hint Trade your b-pawn for Black's
c-pawn.]} (21. Rfc1 $5 {This is an OK developing move, but it's better to
trade off Black's c6-pawn. How should you do that?}) (21. Rb3 $2 Rea8 {Black
has good counterplay on the a-file. Try to find a way to attack the c6-pawn.})
21... Ne6 {Good start! How can you force a beneficial pawn trade?} 22. bxc6 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Trade pawns.
] Great job! Black must either accept a backward pawn on c6 or an isolated
pawn on b7. Either way, White has a vulnerable target to attack. White
eventually won a pawn, but only drew the game in So - Hracek 2016.} (22. Rfc1
$5 {This is an OK developing move, but it's better to give Black a backward or
isolated pawn. How can you do that?}) (22. Rfd1 $5 {This is an OK developing
move, but it's better to give Black a backward or isolated pawn. How can you
do that?}) *

{What surprising move with the g4-knight gives Black a good position?} 16...
N4e5 {[%wrong White wins material. Try to find a good move with the g4-knight.]
[%hint Sacrifice your g4 knight to convince White to open the d-file.]} (16...
Nh6 $2 17. Rad1 {White controls the center with a good game. Try to find a
stronger knight move.}) (16... Nf6 $2 17. e5 {White's strong center provides a
powerful initiative. Try to find a better knight move.}) 17. dxe5 {Great move!
How should you start to win back material?} Nxe5 {[%wrong White keeps a
material advantage. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Capture a
pawn and attack d3.]} (17... Rd7 $5 {This is a good move, but we're going to
capture a pawn and attack d3 at the same time. How can you do that?}) (17...
Bc4 $2 18. Rad1 {White is OK and can meet Rd7 with the clever Nd5! Try to find
a better way to attack d3.}) 18. Rad1 {Great job! How should you keep the
d3-bishop pinned?} Rd7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it and
check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Pin d3 with your rook.]} (18... Bc4 $2
19. Bxc4 {White wins material. Try to find a stronger move to pile up on the
pinned piece.}) (18... Qb6+ $2 19. Kh1 {White will keep a material edge. Try
to find a stronger move to attack d3.}) 19. Nc1 {Good choice! How can you
attack the pinned bishop one more time?} Bc4 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find a way to attack the pinned bishop.] [%hint Attack the pinned
bishop with your bishop.]} (19... Nxd3 $2 20. Nxd3 {This is a good move, but
it's even stronger to attack the pinned again. How can you do it?}) 20. Qc2 {
Great job! How should you win material?} Bxd3 {[%wrong There's a stronger move.
Try to find a good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece and make a fork.] Great
work! Black has an extra pawn and a good position.} (20... Nxd3 $5 {This is a
good capture, but there's another strong one. Try to find that as well.}) (
20... Rxd3 $2 21. Nxd3 {There's no need to sacrifice an exchange. Try to find
a stronger capture.}) *
